title: Athena: An External Reasoning Engine for Retrieval-Augmented Generation — Evaluation Harness and Results
description: Evaluation harness, logic-tree builder, cached logic trees, per-query scores, and raw model outputs for thirteen pipeline configurations evaluated on the MultiHop-RAG benchmark. Supporting materials for the dissertation Optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with an External Reasoning Engine for Enhanced Performance, University of the Cumberlands, 2026.
